test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Novel ‘Train to Pakistan’ dealing with the tragedy of India’s Partition is written by whom among the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khushwant Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khushwant Singh**

 
 
• Khushwant Singh, a former Rajya Sabha member, is the author of **"Train to Pakistan."**
 
• He was a journalist, attorney, and politician from India.
 
• He shared his memories of the **1947 Partition** in "Train to Pakistan."
 
• He was a **Rajya Sabha Member of Parliament from 1980 to 1986**.
 
• In **1974**, Khushwant Singh received the **Padma Bhushan**.
 
• He did, however, return the** honour in 1984 in opposition to Operation Blue Star**.
 
• He received the **Padma Vibhushan in 2007**. 
 
• **Other important books written by him are**:
 
 
• The Voice of God and Other Stories, (Short Story) 1957
 
• Shall Not Hear the Nightingale, 1959
 
• The Sikhs Today, 1959
 
• The End of India, 2003
 
• Burial at the Sea, 2004.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand**

 
 
• **Indian author Mulk Raj Anand** was born on December **12th, 1905**, and is best known for his **portrayals of the lower castes in traditional Indian society**.
 
• His first novel, **"Untouchable," was published in 1935**.
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** was awarded to him in **1968**.
 
 
 
• **Ruskin Bond**
 
 
• **Author Ruskin Bond is Anglo Indian** and was born on **May 19, 1934**.
 
• The** Room on the Roof, his first book, was released in 1956** and was awarded the **John Llewellyn Rhys Prize in 1957**.
 
• In **1999 and 2014**, he received** the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan**, respectively.
 
 
 
• **M L Malgaonkar**
 
 
• **M L Malgonkar**, who was born in **India on July 12th, 1913**, wrote both **fiction and nonfiction works in English**.
 
• His first novel "**The Sea Hawk: Life and Battles of Kanhoji Angrey" **was published in **1959**.
